assumptions: F5 = (a): one PR, one closing keyword per issue (Closes #1666, Closes #1669, Closes #1672). #1666 item 2 is the #1669 decision, so this PR resolves both items of #1666.

#1669 decision (a), exempt, delegated to the build. A .skip test never runs and cannot pass vacuously; LINT-006 exempts it on the same grounds. It leaves `checked` and gets one skip entry ('declared .skip: ...'), so a file whose only tests are .skip abstains rather than passing.

#1672 F6 = (a): covered in the clump. A hook assignment to a module-scope uninitialised let binds the name only when it reaches the target (relative import(/require( makes a handle; a right-hand side naming a direct target makes a one-level helper). Any other assignment leaves the name unresolved, so #1170's abstention still holds.
outOfBandHandles now also reads a relative require( argument, for every same-file declaration, not only hook assignments. This can only add handles, which makes VAC-002 quieter, never noisier.

Hook assignments are matched one line at a time. The first line of a right-hand side Prettier wraps across lines IS read (e.g. `template = buildGitTemplate('...', (d) => {` binds `template` as a one-level helper); only the continuation lines are not read.
JS_PLAIN_ASSIGN matches a plain assignment anywhere in the file, not only inside a beforeEach/beforeAll hook, so a non-hook assignment can also bind a name. Tracked in #1681.

Dogfood delta (vacuity-check, base vs head): ts/test VAC-002 170 -> 165, skipped 575 -> 572, checked unchanged (5574); agents/skills/test checked 1747 -> 1738 (9 .skip tests), VAC-001 1 -> 0 (the reservations.spec.js fixture). Three former 'deeper' abstentions in branch-prune/refresh-baseline-push-job now read as invoked, because `root = copyGitTemplate(...)` is a one-level helper exactly as the `const` form already is.

Disclosed after review: the VAC-002 drop of 5 (170 -> 165) is 4 correct parity fixes (ts/test/parity.test.ts:107, :120, :129, :135) plus 1 FALSE NEGATIVE at ts/test/refresh-baseline-push-job.test.ts:220. That test's body is only `expect(hookSpawns).toBe(0)`, but helperVerdict (ts/src/core/vacuity-scanner.ts:996-1006) reads the raw body including comments; its trailing comment mentions `template`, which is now a one-level helper name, so the test reads as invoking the target. The comment-mention root cause predates this PR; this PR only made `template` a resolvable name. Tracked in #1681. (Source: base 448969ff vs head c8690dea scan over 439 test files.)
